query: Consider the Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement between Roundhouse and Creative; Does the document mention that some obligations of the Agreement may survive the termination of the Agreement?
gold: The requirement to protect Confidential Information disclosed under this Agreement shall survive termination of this Agreement.
rag_answer: Yes. Clause 9 of the Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement states that the requirement to protect Confidential Information disclosed under the Agreement shall survive termination of the Agreement.
